levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The sequence is broken into disconnected pieces with restarts, or a part (introduction or closing) is skipped.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The full sequence is completed in one continuous pass.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The full sequence is completed continuously and the transitions between parts feel natural.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Learner reads most of the sequence directly from notes.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Learner delivers most of the sequence from memory, glancing at notes occasionally.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Learner delivers the full sequence fluently without notes.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection addresses only individual answers, not the sequence as a whole.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names a real difference between practicing pieces and running the whole sequence.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names a specific transition point that was harder, and connects it to the feedback received.

lookFors: The introduction and closing question are both genuinely delivered, not skipped for time.
The post-interview notes name a specific transition point, not a vague 'it went well.'
The reflection distinguishes sequence-level flow from individual answer quality.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
